title: Warmly Spiced American Tofu Skewers
description: A pungent and crispy American dish featuring allspice berries and lacquer-glaze, perfect for crowds, and shojin-friendly. This recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground allspice berries, lacquer glaze, maple syrup, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated tofu onto the soaked bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the warmly spiced American tofu skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
